entries.topic: Public opinion for switching on the car news
originals: Whether turning on the news lowers public opinion (wiki) or only the fire…
News opinion? Is the first ↓ applied on turning the TV on…
WATCH NEWS: no arrow for watching…
entries.question: In the car, with Zlatko's house NOT burned, did a Public Opinion ↓ popup appear at any point while you watched the TV news (yes/no)?
entries.why: Template (dbt21 'Watch the news') puts its only PublicOpinion SmallDown inside CONDITION GROUP 'IF Kara set the house on fire in Zlatko'; the wiki chapter page ('Turning on news {{Icon|down}}') and Public_Opinion ('Watching the news in the car at the start of The Pirates' Cove') both add a second ↓. Other chapters' templates (ch12, ch13, ch17) do mark TV-news arrows, so an omission here is plausible but unproven. The second half of the question is settled: the fourth (fire) report exists only with the fire (template condition group; Public_Opinion '(Only if Kara set fire to Zlatko's mansion)'), as built in K14b option 1.

originals: How many Alice increases, and on which beats?
Whether the story ending gives Alice a small up (wiki) or not (template)?
End of the story: no Alice arrow…
entries.answer: Three small ups: an automatic one at the start of the poster talk (after the bed), an automatic one after any poster answer, and KISS. No arrow on any story pick or story ending, and no answer to the poster question is singled out. Relationship_Stat also lists exactly three (bed, KISS, story end); it differs from the template only in placing the second automatic ↑ at the story end instead of the poster, and both beats are unconditional on the single path, so the chapter total is identical. Only the wiki chapter page's list of four disagrees.
entries.source: dbt template 'Talking to Alice': ARROW Alice SmallUp before PROMPT 3 and after it; PROMPT 4 'KISS' ARROW Alice SmallUp; no ARROW in PROMPTS 5–12. Relationship_Stat Small Increase list (Pirates' Cove: bed, kiss, story end).
